description: This file exposes the C API of a configuration mechanism for testing purposes, providing command-line interface functions to retrieve and iterate over configuration data, including reading early configs, getting values in various formats, and iterating over all config entries.

methods.name: cmd__config
methods.description: Main function handling various configuration commands based on command-line arguments, including getting values, multi-values, iterating, and reading early configs.

methods.name: iterate_cb
methods.description: Callback function to iterate over all configuration entries and print their details.

methods.name: parse_int_cb
methods.description: Callback function to parse and print integer value for a specific key.

methods.name: early_config_cb
methods.description: Callback function to print early configuration values for a specific key.
